answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning, proven by a cipher challenge bound to one hardware key per identity. A farm creating 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 POA, while an honest agent risks only a refundable stake. Reputation then grows like a vine: each verified job adds one link, and identities with fewer than 20 links cannot draw payouts. When graph checks find 50 identities sharing one device fingerprint or payout wallet, the cluster is slashed 40% and frozen, like a velvet rope that admits only guests whose invites trace to hosts.
